ppe_detection.notes: Worker on the ladder top is unprotected.

hazards.hazard: Unprotected excavation edge with workers nearby
hazards.remedy: Barricade the edge, keep spoil at least 0.6 m back, and shore or slope the trench wall (OSHA 1926.651).

hazards.hazard: Overhead load handled with people underneath
hazards.remedy: Set an exclusion zone and use a banksman for all lifts.

hazards.hazard: Temporary electrical cable on wet ground
hazards.remedy: Lift cables off the ground, use RCD protection, and replace damaged insulation.

summary: Several workers lack basic PPE and an open trench has no edge protection. Stop work in this area until it is made safe.
